class.name: DisEntityTypeMap
class.brief_description: Chooses the scene that represents a remote entity, from its DIS entity type.
class.description: A [Resource] holding a list of [DisEntityTypeMapping] and a [member default_scene]. A [DisEntityManager] looks up the entity type of every new remote entity here and instances the resulting scene as the child of its [DisRemoteEntity]. An entity type has 7 fields (SISO-REF-010): kind, domain, country, category, subcategory, specific, extra. The mapping that matches the entity type with the most non-wildcard fields wins; between equally specific mappings the one earlier in [member mappings] wins. If no mapping matches, or the winner has no scene, [member default_scene] is used. [codeblock] var tank := DisEntityTypeMapping.new() tank.entity_type = "1:1" # every land platform tank.scene = preload("res://tank.tscn") var map := DisEntityTypeMap.new() map.mappings = [tank] map.default_scene = preload("res://generic.tscn") $DisEntityManager.type_map = map [/codeblock]

method.name: find_mapping
method.description: Returns the [DisEntityTypeMapping] in [member mappings] that matches [param entity_type] with the highest specificity (see [method DisEntityTypeMapping.get_specificity]); ties go to the earliest entry. Returns [code]null[/code] if none matches. Null entries and objects of other classes in the array are skipped.

method.name: find_scene
method.description: Returns the scene of the mapping found by [method find_mapping], or [member default_scene] if there is no match or the matching mapping has no scene. May return [code]null[/code].

method.name: parse_pattern
method.description: Parses an entity type pattern of up to 7 colon-separated fields and returns it as a [PackedInt32Array] of 7 values, where [code]-1[/code] stands for a wildcard ([code]*[/code] or a field left out at the end). Fields must be non-negative integers of at most 9 digits. Returns an empty array if the pattern is invalid. For example [code]"1:2:*:1"[/code] gives [code][1, 2, -1, 1, -1, -1, -1][/code].

members.member: Scene used when no mapping matches, or the matching mapping has no scene. If [code]null[/code], such entities get no visual child.
The list of [DisEntityTypeMapping] resources to search.
